title: Robinson
label: Polydor Records
description: Released as SPITZ's 11th single in 1995, 'Robinson' became the band's breakthrough hit and one of the defining songs of 1990s Japanese rock. Despite peaking at No. 4 on the Oricon Singles Chart, its remarkable longevity and word-of-mouth popularity helped it become a million-selling classic. The song is celebrated for its shimmering guitar melodies, poetic lyrics, and timeless, dreamlike atmosphere.
